privileged_info_for_vlm: The database 'demodb' contains exactly 3 fraudulent profiles seeded with overlapping stays. These profiles are deterministically generated. The agent must set 'Suspicious=true' on these specific Profile vertices and output their emails to '/home/ga/suspicious_travelers.json'. The ground truth is stored at '/var/lib/orientdb/ground_truth_anomalies.json', which the agent should not access.
